capabilities: display lunar dates, festivals, solar terms and statutory holidays
switch between month view and year view
create daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly or yearly notes by clicking a date
pass lunar and date fields to QuickAdd template commands
configure layout options like first day of week, compact mode and scaling
extras: README is mostly in Chinese; the author notes limited maintenance time due to work and lists a TODO of future features (i18n, mobile support, reminders, Templater support). Holiday data for statutory holidays is added per year (2025 and 2026 entries in the changelog).
problem: Obsidian's calendar displays don't show Chinese lunar dates, traditional festivals, solar terms or official holiday/调休 schedules.

relations.evidence: 本插件依赖插件 Periodic Notes 请提前安装并启用
支持使用QuickAdd的模板功能创建笔记，需要传入对应的模板命令

summary: Chinese-style calendar view showing lunar dates, festivals, solar terms and holidays, with month/year views and click-to-create periodic notes.
